died.name: Xuanzang
died.desc: Chinese Buddhist monk, scholar, traveler and translator
died.last_words: I desire that whatever merits I may have gained by good works may fall upon other people. May I be born again with them in the heaven of the blessed, be admitted to the family of Mi-le, and serve the Buddha of the future, who is full of kindness and affection. When I descend again upon earth, to pass through other forms of existence, I desire at every new birth to fulfill my duties toward Buddha, and arrive at the end to the highest perfect intelligence.

died.name: William Cullen
died.last_words: I wish I had the power of writing, for then I would describe to you how pleasant a thing it is to die.

died.name: Thomas Lynn Bradford
died.cause: In an attempt to ascertain the existence of an afterlife, the 48-year-old spiritualist committed suicide by inert gas asphyxiation. Two spiritualists later claimed to have talked with his ghost.

died.name: Edith Ewing Bouvier Beale
died.cause: to her daughter, Edith Bouvier Beale, referring to the documentary Grey Gardens
died.last_words: There's nothing more to say. It's all in the film.
